title: Add P104 flag 0 coefficient transport audit
body:
# Audit the exact native coefficient for P104 joint flag 0

## Summary

Adds a bounded exact row audit for the first flag in PR #2981's 208-flag
collection: source `X0`, target `Y34`, basis head `232`.

The pinned doubled E8 roots have raw dot product `4` and squared norm `8`. The
native channel therefore contributes `+1/2` to this off-diagonal entry, while
the complementary `I-G/2` term requires `-1/2`. A one-hot `x0=z` replay through
the pinned 4,058-event word follows the target coefficient through events
2815 (`+z/2`), 2998 (`-z/2`), and 3369 (`+z/2`), finishing at `Y34 = z/2`.

This complements PR #3242's event-order scan and the pooled fixed-cover support
reviews in PRs #3259, #3803, and #3810. It checks an actual native coefficient
row for one flag; the three additions do not implement the side correction.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -I -B research/p104-flag0-coefficient-transport/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-flag0-coefficient-transport --check-only
python3 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-flag0-coefficient-transport
```

Local exact replay passed on CPython 3.14.8. The registered Python 3.12 replay
remains pending because that interpreter is unavailable in the local
environment.

## Scope and limits

No correction program, arbitrary-dirty restoration, correction-frame
availability, full bill, supplier admission, new kappa, or selected-frontier
change is claimed. The one-hot fixture sets dirty coefficients to zero and uses
the coefficient-row invariant in the reviewed native-channel proof. It does not
re-run the native Clifford/all-column checker.

Credit Nick Petalas / PR #2981 for the static flag; Rohan Arun / PR #1972 and
Chafik Boukhalfa / PR #1991 for the channel; and jwr404 / PR #3242 for the
event chronology. No independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed.

## Current overlap

Open PR #3882 submits a P104 correction-tail construction. This package checks one native coefficient row for flag 0 and does not construct a correction program.

## Publication validation

`python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-flag0-coefficient-transport` passed on CPython 3.12.3, and `python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-flag0-coefficient-transport --check-source-history` passed. The registered replay left the worktree clean. This supersedes any earlier pending note above for the registered package replay; separate full selected cold-replay limits remain as stated.
